## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 22, 2026 - Sep 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _VanSaysSo_, Sep 22, 2026, 2/5: "This app continues to get farther away from where it started - it was the best. The new update forces free users into a toxic, outdated "eat back your exercise calories" model. Every time I move, my macro goals shift automatically, treating food like a transaction or a reward for working out. It’s incredibly weight-watchers-esque and mentally unhealthy. The fact that MyFitnessPal forces this fluctuating target on free users—and locks the simple ability to freeze your goals behind a $20/month premium paywall—is predatory. There is literally an automatic calorie/macro adjustment every time a free user logs exercise or steps. This is an unhealthy, obsessive way to track food. The goals change constantly throughout the day, creating a frustratingly moving target. Turning this stressful feature off shouldn’t be a Premium feature, nor should we have to disable steps and fitness tracking in the app to stop this outdated model. Disappointed to see this app prioritize aggressive paywalls over user mental health."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Sep 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Honest, not rude_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be great and the free version was doable for people who didn’t have the money. Unfortunately it seems like the company went for a money grab and now there’s ads every-time I open, log or look up an item. So many ads that it blocks the function of the app and freezes the screen. Happily moving to an app with less greed intentions off their customers."
            2. _RuachOo_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "The app has become so bloated over the years its extremely slow, and the unnecessary praising and popups is super annoying. Less clicks = better experience. It also often just freezes for 10seconds before responding again when i open the app"
            3. _Lovely13675_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "I ahve used this app since it first came on the scene . The past couple of months it freezes every day! I have tried all the fixes. I will need to find a different way to track intakes..hate to go."
